name: Hanoi
summary: Hanoi combines ancient temples, urban lakes and a chaotic Old Quarter with a world-class street food scene, all at a very low cost of living. The city has a growing but still low-key digital nomad community, with office cafes everywhere and a relaxed work culture compared to the hustle and bustle of Bangkok or Bali.
strengths: Low cost of livingEUR 408/month — 53% below the average of the 90 cities
Fast Internet274 Mbps — 55% above average (176 Mbps)
considerations: Quality of life below average4.5/10 compared to an average of 6.9/10
